case_number: 2025 INSC 448; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) No. 19139 of 2024)
summary: Valid D. El. Ed. qualification dispute; 18-month NIOS course for in-service untrained teachers under RTE Act; relaxation valid if completed by 31/3/2019; Jaiveer Singh precedent applies; Viswanath clarification confirms eligibility for teachers trained within deadline; impugned disqualification set aside; TET and other criteria still applicable.
legal_provisions_cited: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 s.23
Jaiveer Singh & Ors. vs. The State of Uttarakhand & Ors. (2023 SCC Online SC 1584)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court judgment set aside; appellants eligible if criteria met.
